name: DropdownMenu
description: A menu surface anchored below the widget that opened it, plus the showShadcnDropdown helper. Rows, traversal and the popup surface come from the menu component.

theme.note: DropdownMenu takes a MenuPopupTheme as its widget-leg surface override; it declares no theme of its own.

accessibility.keyboard: menu traversal (ArrowUp/Down, Home/End, ArrowRight/Left for submenus, Escape, typeahead); outside taps close the menu
accessibility.semantics: rows are menu buttons; disabled rows dim to 50% opacity

sizes.surface: MenuPopup defaults: min-width 192 (12rem), padding 4, 1px border, radius md

notes: DropdownMenuTheme (surfaceOpacity/surfaceBlur only) is deleted: the surface* fields were dropped with the dialog pilot and MenuPopup owns the surface tokens.
DropdownMenuData (regionGroupId plumbing) is deleted; one popover per menu no longer needs region grouping.
The drawer dependency is gone: the sheet-overlay marker comes from primitives/sheet_overlay.dart, not the drawer component.
showShadcnDropdown returns a Future<T?> instead of the old OverlayCompleter; showShadcnMenu remains the row-menu helper for submenus inside menus.
